newsitem.title: USA: Rental Service files for stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Rental Service files for stock offering.

text.p: Rental Service Corp filed on Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of four million shares of common stock, including one million that are being offered by current shareholders.

Proceeds will be used to reduce the company's debt under its revolving credit facility so that it will have borrowing availability for general corporate purposes, including acquisitions, the company said.
Underwriters William Blair & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp have been offered an overallotment option of an additional 600,000 shares, it said.
